desc: Derive feasibility: a divisor d is usable for A_i iff d divides A_i and at least K input values are divisible by d.
Design the O(M log M) frequency-array multiples-sieve computation.
Determine that descending feasible divisors with first-write assignment gives every value its largest feasible divisor.
Implement the dense frequency-array multiples sieve in Python, using descending feasible-divisor assignment, and verify all provided samples.
Ensure fast stdin parsing and buffered stdout output are suitable for N up to 1.2×10^6.
